source: production Supabase Postgres (project scryfkefedzuetfdtrvl) via a live schema dump
target: isolated local Postgres database kinnso_restore in the disposable stack

dump.command: pg_dump --schema-only --no-owner --no-privileges -n public -n kinnso_internal -n supabase_migrations -n kinnso_share_api -n app_private
dump.note: Platform auth functions and the extensions schema were stubbed in the empty target (auth.uid/jwt/role/email, pgcrypto) because they are platform-managed, not product objects.

keyRowRestore.note: Restored with session_replication_role=replica so platform auth.users rows did not have to be replicated into the rehearsal target.

limits: This exercises the product schema and key rows, not the platform PITR/snapshot restore path, which remains a Supabase-managed operation and is not verified here.
Platform-managed schemas (auth, realtime, storage, extensions) were stubbed or excluded, so this is not a byte-identical full-cluster restore.
The rehearsal target is disposable and was left in place for inspection.
